by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ A B X Y hAB hs hang
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hmB := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hsign := hs.oangle_sign_eq hmA hmB
  have heq := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_of_angle_eq_of_sign_eq hang hsign.symm
  have hc : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, X, Y, B} : Set P) := by
    refine EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_of_two_zsmul_oangle_eq_of_not_collinear (by rw [heq]) ?_
    intro hcol
    exact hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB)
  exact hc.subset (by intro x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
